title: finding(plugin-detail): on the record page's discussion, a stored reply never shows and the reply input is never drawn, because nothing sets replyCount on read
body:
Filing gate ①: a product defect with a named producer. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat 2 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#9771, `session_01TYgwmFK1q4KJ6Qq2WRLzsD`) from an out-of-scope finding in the objectui#12082 round-2 dev report (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12140, report comment `6109609151`). The seat re-read the code below before filing. ⛔ Not a claim.

## Read on objectui `6dea96f` (PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12140's head; these lines are unchanged from `main`)

- `reach:` named real producer. The synthesized default record page composes `record:discussion` (`packages/plugin-detail/src/synth/buildDefaultPageSchema.ts` about `:969`). That block renders through `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-chatter.tsx`, whose config sets `feed.enableThreading: true` (about `:172`). So threading is on for every record's default page.
- With threading on, `packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordActivityTimeline.tsx` does two things:
  - it removes every item with a `parentId` from the top-level list (about `:298`);
  - it draws `ThreadedReplies` only when `item.replyCount > 0` (about `:634`). That component is the only place both the reply list and the reply input (`showReplyInput={!!onAddReply}`) render.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx` maps each `sys_comment` row read to a `FeedItem` with `parentId` but never `replyCount` (about `:2113`). Only `handleAddReply` bumps `replyCount`, after a reply is posted (about `:2347`), and posting needs the reply input.
- Result, from the code read:
  - a reply stored on the server is shown neither at the top level nor under its parent;
  - no comment read from the server offers a reply input, so the first reply on a comment cannot be posted from the page.

  NOT MEASURED at a running page: this is a code read.

## Done when

- On the default record page, a stored reply is shown under its parent after a reload.
- A comment with no replies offers the reply input wherever the host hands over `onAddReply`.
- Pins, through the record page's feed:
  - a `sys_comment` read with a parent and one child shows the child under the parent;
  - a parent with no child offers the reply input;
  - CONTROL: with threading off, the list is unchanged.

## Who acts, and in what order

- The `domain:ui` execution seat, after triage grades this card.
- Serial: after PR objectstack-ai/objectui#12140 lands. It edits `RecordDetailView.tsx`'s feed handlers.

## Dedupe

Two repo-scoped issue searches on objectui, open and closed:

- "record feed threaded replies hidden after reload replyCount never derived reply input unreachable": 0 hits.
- "comment reply parent_id reply count discussion thread not shown": 1 hit, objectui#875 (closed; the discussion panel absent from a drawer, a different defect).
